rules.rationale: Delivery flow is limiting the speed and safety of change.
rules.action: Map one value stream and automate its build, test, and deployment path.

rules.rationale: Operational feedback is not yet consistently shaping improvement.
rules.action: Define one user-focused service indicator and review it with every release.

rules.rationale: Security controls are creating late feedback or inconsistent coverage.
rules.action: Add automated dependency and container scanning with an explicit severity policy.

rules.rationale: Decision quality is constrained by inconsistent or delayed information.
rules.action: Choose one critical outcome and publish its owner, definition, source, and freshness.

rules.rationale: Developer friction is consuming time that could create customer value.
rules.action: Measure the path from repository creation to first production deployment and remove its largest delay.

rules.rationale: Learning and adaptation are not yet consistently reinforced.
rules.action: Run a blameless learning review and track one systemic improvement to completion.
